title: Shimon HaAmsoni
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Pesachim 22b relates that he expounded every et in the Torah. When he reached “You shall fear et the Lord your God,” he withdrew. His students asked what would become of all the et interpretations. He replied, “Just as I was rewarded for expounding, I will be rewarded for withdrawing.” Then Rabbi Akiva came and expounded, etc. See Nechemyah HaAmsoni.

notes.text: פירש means withdrew from this exposition, not explained. The later appearance of Rabbi Akiva belongs to the narration rather than inside Shimon’s quoted answer.
The consulted Pesachim 22b introduces Shimon HaAmsoni, or according to another version Nechemyah HaAmsoni. Hyman’s separate heading and cross-reference are preserved without merging identities.
